+package kgateway

+// ConsistentHash configures the route-level hash policies used by hashing load balancers
+// (e.g. RingHash, Maglev) to compute the hash key of a request.
+//
+// Setting an empty object (`{}`) enables consistent hashing based on the request's source IP.
+// Hash policies are evaluated in the following order: headers, cookies, queryParameters,
+// filterState, sourceIp.
+//
+// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.disable) || !self.disable || (!has(self.headers) && !has(self.cookies) && !has(self.queryParameters) && !has(self.filterState) && !has(self.sourceIp))",message="no other fields may be set when disable is true"
+type ConsistentHash struct {
+	// Disable suppresses consistent hashing on the targeted resources, including any
+	// hash policies inherited from broader-scoped policies.
+	// When true, no other fields may be set.
+	// +optional
+	Disable *bool `json:"disable,omitempty"`
+
+	// Headers specifies request headers whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by headerName (case-insensitive); the first occurrence wins.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Headers []HeaderHashPolicy `json:"headers,omitempty"`
+
+	// Cookies specifies cookies whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by name; the first occurrence wins.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Cookies []CookieHashPolicy `json:"cookies,omitempty"`
+
+	// QueryParameters specifies URL query parameters whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by name; the first occurrence wins.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	QueryParameters []QueryParameterHashPolicy `json:"queryParameters,omitempty"`
+
+	// FilterState specifies filter state objects whose values are used as components of the hash key.
+	// Entries are deduplicated by key; the first occurrence wins.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	FilterState []FilterStateHashPolicy `json:"filterState,omitempty"`
+
+	// SourceIP specifies that the request's source IP address is used as a component of the hash key.
+	// +optional
+	SourceIP *SourceIPHashPolicy `json:"sourceIp,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// HeaderHashPolicy uses a request header's value as a component of the hash key.
+type HeaderHashPolicy struct {
+	// HeaderName is the name of the request header.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	HeaderName string `json:"headerName"`
+
+	// RegexRewrite, if set, rewrites the header value using the regex before it is hashed.
+	// +optional
+	RegexRewrite *HashRegexRewrite `json:"regexRewrite,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set, and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, will cause Envoy
+	// to skip the subsequent policies and use the key as it is.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// HashRegexRewrite specifies a regex rewrite applied to a value before it is hashed.
+type HashRegexRewrite struct {
+	// Pattern is the regex pattern to match. It must be a valid RE2 regular expression.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Pattern string `json:"pattern"`
+
+	// Substitution is the replacement string for the matched pattern.
+	// It can include backreferences to captured groups from the pattern (e.g., \1, \2).
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Substitution string `json:"substitution"`
+}
+
+// CookieHashPolicy uses a cookie's value as a component of the hash key.
+type CookieHashPolicy struct {
+	// Name of the cookie.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// TTL specifies the time to live of the cookie. If specified, a cookie with the TTL will be
+	// generated if the cookie is not present. If the TTL is present and zero, the generated cookie
+	// will be a session cookie.
+	// Accepts a Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600").
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="matches(self, '^([0-9]{1,10}|([0-9]{1,5}(h|m|s|ms)){1,4})$')",message="ttl must be a duration (e.g. 1h30m) or an integer number of seconds"
+	TTL *string `json:"ttl,omitempty"`
+
+	// Path is the path for the generated cookie.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Path *string `json:"path,omitempty"`
+
+	// Attributes are additional attributes set on the generated cookie (e.g. SameSite, Secure).
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxItems=16
+	Attributes []CookieHashAttribute `json:"attributes,omitempty"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set, and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, will cause Envoy
+	// to skip the subsequent policies and use the key as it is.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// CookieHashAttribute is an attribute set on a generated cookie.
+type CookieHashAttribute struct {
+	// Name of the cookie attribute, e.g. SameSite or Secure.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Value of the cookie attribute.
+	// +optional
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=1024
+	Value string `json:"value,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// QueryParameterHashPolicy uses a URL query parameter's value as a component of the hash key.
+type QueryParameterHashPolicy struct {
+	// Name of the URL query parameter.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Name string `json:"name"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set, and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, will cause Envoy
+	// to skip the subsequent policies and use the key as it is.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// FilterStateHashPolicy uses a filter state object's value as a component of the hash key.
+type FilterStateHashPolicy struct {
+	// Key is the name of the filter state object.
+	// +required
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MinLength=1
+	// +kubebuilder:validation:MaxLength=256
+	Key string `json:"key"`
+
+	// Terminal, if set, and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, will cause Envoy
+	// to skip the subsequent policies and use the key as it is.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}
+
+// SourceIPHashPolicy uses the request's source IP address as a component of the hash key.
+type SourceIPHashPolicy struct {
+	// Terminal, if set, and a hash key is available after evaluating this policy, will cause Envoy
+	// to skip the subsequent policies and use the key as it is.
+	// +optional
+	Terminal *bool `json:"terminal,omitempty"`
+}

+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,302 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"cmp"
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+// hashPolicyType is the canonical order in which hash policies are emitted
+type hashPolicyType int
+
+const (
+	hashPolicyTypeHeader hashPolicyType = iota
+	hashPolicyTypeCookie
+	hashPolicyTypeQueryParameter
+	hashPolicyTypeFilterState
+	hashPolicyTypeSourceIP
+	hashPolicyTypeUnknown
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	// disable suppresses all hash policies, including those inherited from broader-scoped policies
+	disable bool
+	// policies are the hash policies in canonical type order, deduplicated by their identifying key.
+	// If empty and disable is false, a default source IP hash policy is applied.
+	policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.policies, otherCH.policies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	})
+}
+
+// Validate performs validation on the consistent hash component.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, p := range c.policies {
+		if pattern := p.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern(); pattern != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(pattern.GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash header regexRewrite pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// hashPolicies returns the hash policies to set on the route, or nil if consistent hashing is disabled
+func (c *consistentHashIR) hashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if len(c.policies) == 0 {
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{sourceIPHashPolicy(false)}
+	}
+	return c.policies
+}
+
+// constructConsistentHash constructs the consistent hash policy IR from the policy specification.
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+	if ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable {
+		ir.disable = true
+		out.consistentHash = ir
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{Header: hp},
+			Terminal:        derefBool(h.Terminal),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		cp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil {
+			ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid consistentHash cookie %q ttl: %w", c.Name, err)
+			}
+			cp.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttl)
+		}
+		if c.Path != nil {
+			cp.Path = *c.Path
+		}
+		for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+			cp.Attributes = append(cp.Attributes, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  attr.Name,
+				Value: attr.Value,
+			})
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{Cookie: cp},
+			Terminal:        derefBool(c.Terminal),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: derefBool(q.Terminal),
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: derefBool(f.Terminal),
+		})
+	}
+
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, sourceIPHashPolicy(derefBool(ch.SourceIP.Terminal)))
+	}
+
+	ir.policies = dedupeHashPolicies(policies)
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+// mergeConsistentHashIR unions the hash policies of preferred and other, with the entries of preferred first.
+// Entries are deduplicated by their identifying key and re-sorted into canonical type order.
+// The source IP hash policy is always taken from preferred, even when unset.
+func mergeConsistentHashIR(preferred, other *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if preferred.disable || other.disable {
+		// preferred takes precedence over a disabled lower priority policy, and a disabled
+		// preferred policy suppresses everything from the lower priority policy
+		return preferred
+	}
+	merged := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(preferred.policies)+len(other.policies))
+	merged = append(merged, preferred.policies...)
+	for _, p := range other.policies {
+		if hashPolicyKind(p) == hashPolicyTypeSourceIP {
+			continue
+		}
+		merged = append(merged, p)
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		policies: dedupeHashPolicies(merged),
+	}
+}
+
+// dedupeHashPolicies returns a new slice with duplicate entries (by type and identifying key) removed,
+// keeping the first occurrence, stably sorted into canonical type order.
+func dedupeHashPolicies(in []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(in) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	type key struct {
+		kind hashPolicyType
+		id   string
+	}
+	seen := make(map[key]struct{}, len(in))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(in))
+	for _, p := range in {
+		k := key{kind: hashPolicyKind(p), id: hashPolicyID(p)}
+		if _, ok := seen[k]; ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[k] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, p)
+	}
+	slices.SortStableFunc(out, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+		return cmp.Compare(hashPolicyKind(a), hashPolicyKind(b))
+	})
+	return out
+}
+
+func hashPolicyKind(p *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) hashPolicyType {
+	switch p.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+		return hashPolicyTypeHeader
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+		return hashPolicyTypeCookie
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+		return hashPolicyTypeQueryParameter
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+		return hashPolicyTypeFilterState
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+		return hashPolicyTypeSourceIP
+	default:
+		return hashPolicyTypeUnknown
+	}
+}
+
+// hashPolicyID returns the identifying key of the hash policy within its type
+func hashPolicyID(p *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+	switch hashPolicyKind(p) {
+	case hashPolicyTypeHeader:
+		// HTTP headers are case-insensitive
+		return strings.ToLower(p.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+	case hashPolicyTypeCookie:
+		return p.GetCookie().GetName()
+	case hashPolicyTypeQueryParameter:
+		return p.GetQueryParameter().GetName()
+	case hashPolicyTypeFilterState:
+		return p.GetFilterState().GetKey()
+	default:
+		return ""
+	}
+}
+
+func sourceIPHashPolicy(terminal bool) *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+		Terminal: terminal,
+	}
+}
+
+// parseCookieTTL parses a Go duration string (e.g. "1h30m") or an integer number of seconds (e.g. "3600")
+func parseCookieTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("must not be negative: %q", s)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}
+
+func derefBool(b *bool) bool {
+	return b != nil && *b
+}
+
+// applyConsistentHash applies the consistent hash configuration to the Envoy route action.
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies()
+}

+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
